title: Pass@k and Majority Voting Evaluation Metrics

blocks.text: Pass@k measures the chance that a size-k subset contains a success; voting answers a different question. The task is: Return the unbiased pass@k estimate for n samples with correct successes, plus the most frequent hashable answer. Require 1<=k<=n and 0<=correct<=n; ties follow first occurrence.

The inputs are `n`, `correct`, `k`, `answers`. Keep their roles separate while you trace the solution. The animation follows the supplied implementation, so every highlighted operation connects to code you can inspect.
